lines.beaver: 요즘 코인 투자, 다들 해요. 같이 해 볼래요?
lines.beaver_en: Everyone's into crypto these days. Want to try it with me?
lines.beaver_roman: yojeum koin tuja, dadeul haeyo. gachi hae bollaeyo?
lines.learner: 고맙지만 저는 한탕을 노리는 투자는 안 해요.
lines.en: Thanks, but I don't make investments that chase one big score.
lines.roman: gomapjiman jeoneun hantangeul norineun tujaneun an haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then how do you manage your money?
lines.learner: 저는 재테크 원칙으로 절약을 첫째로 꼽아요.
lines.en: I pick saving as my number one money rule.
lines.roman: jeoneun jaetekeu wonchigeuro jeoryageul cheotjjaero kkobayo.

lines.beaver_en: Isn't life hard when you save that much?
lines.learner: 괜찮아요. 돈을 헤프게 쓰지 않을 뿐이에요.
lines.en: It's fine. I just don't waste money.
lines.roman: gwaenchanayo. doneul heopeuge sseuji aneul ppunieyo.

lines.beaver_en: Still, you should splurge once in a while.
lines.en: I've found extravagant spending is where money troubles begin.

lines.beaver: 돈 관리에 대해 더 말해 줄래요?
lines.beaver_en: Can you tell me more about managing money?
lines.beaver_roman: don gwallie daehae deo malhae jullaeyo?
lines.learner: 단돈 천 원도 기록하고, 카드 대금은 바로 내요.
lines.en: I record even a mere 1,000 won, and pay card bills right away.
lines.roman: dandon cheon wondo girokago, kadeu daegeumeun baro naeyo.

lines.beaver: 처음엔 모아 둔 돈이 좀 있었어요?
lines.beaver_en: Did you have some savings at first?
lines.beaver_roman: cheoeumen moa dun doni jom isseosseoyo?
lines.learner: 아니요, 상속받은 돈이 없어서 처음엔 곤궁했어요.
lines.en: No, I had no inheritance, so I was poor at first.
lines.roman: aniyo, sangsokbadeun doni eopseoseo cheoeumen gongunghaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: That must have been really hard.
lines.learner: 네, 그래서 지금은 비상금을 꼭 모아 둬요.
lines.en: Yes, so now I always keep emergency savings.
lines.roman: ne, geuraeseo jigeumeun bisanggeumeul kkok moa dwoyo.

lines.beaver: 그래도 투자로 빨리 풍족해지고 싶지 않아요?
lines.beaver_en: But don't you want to get well-off fast by investing?
lines.beaver_roman: geuraedo tujaro ppalli pungjokaejigo sipji anayo?
lines.learner: 풍족하지 않아도 마음 편한 게 더 좋아요.
lines.en: I'd rather have peace of mind than be well-off.
lines.roman: pungjokaji anado maeum pyeonhan ge deo joayo.

lines.beaver: 듣고 보니 제가 너무 서둘렀나 봐요.
lines.beaver_en: Hearing that, I guess I was rushing too much.
lines.beaver_roman: deutgo boni jega neomu seodulleonna bwayo.
lines.en: It's okay. Consistency is also one of my key rules.

lines.beaver: 좋은 이야기 고마워요. 저도 다시 생각해 볼게요.
lines.beaver_en: Thanks for the good advice. I'll rethink it too.
lines.beaver_roman: joeun iyagi gomawoyo. jeodo dasi saenggakae bolgeyo.
lines.learner: 네, 천천히 같이 공부해 봐요. 다음에 또 얘기해요.
lines.en: Sure, let's study it slowly together. Talk again soon.
lines.roman: ne, cheoncheonhi gachi gongbuhae bwayo. daeume tto yaegihaeyo.
